title: ABOUT AI FOUNDRY
paragraphs: AI Foundry is the go-to spot for student creators at Dayananda Sagar University. We turn cool campus ideas into real-world tech by giving you the right mentors, beastly GPU power, and a local community that helps you grow. It's where the future of AI hits the road.

Whether you're fine-tuning custom LLMs, building autonomous agents, designing slick interfaces, or pitching your first venture, you won't be doing it alone. From late-night hackathons and hands-on build sprints to demo days in front of industry veterans, we give you the launchpad to stop just talking about AI and start shipping it.

Branded as RAISE AI (Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Student Engineers) under the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (AI & ML), AI Foundry unites engineers, designers, researchers, and student founders to forge impactful technologies.

title: CLUB INAUGURATION & VISION
paragraphs: Inaugurated under the esteemed guidance of Dr. Jayavrinda Vrindavanam V, Chairperson of CSE (AI & ML), along with faculty advisors Dr. M Lakshmanan and Dr. A. A. Nippun Kumaar, the club unites visionary students and research mentors.
Through industry hackathons, venture pitch nights, and hands-on LLM bootcamps, AI Foundry equips undergraduates with real-world engineering and venture-building capabilities before graduation.
